title: Strict preconditions for canonical regeneration (manifest digest pin + PROJ authority)

defect_summary.lenient_manifest: regen._verify_manifest called verify_inputs_manifest WITHOUT strict mode: a required generation input left status='pending' was reported but never digest-checked and never blocked canonical regeneration.
defect_summary.lenient_proj: regen._check_proj_env called check_proj_environment(fail_closed=False): old/unknown proj.db layout and FOREIGN PROJ_LIB/PROJ_DATA env vars were loud warnings only, so canonical regen could silently proceed with ambiguous projection authority (silent-reprojection risk).
defect_summary.no_provenance_binding: emitted provenance recorded the manifest path string only; the manifest's own digest and the required/checked/pending/unused sets were not captured, so a later regen could not prove which inputs were actually verified.

corrected_semantics.verify_inputs_manifest(require_pinned_ke: Every required key must be present in the manifest AND digest-verified on disk. A required key that is missing, pending, or unverified raises InputsManifestError with per-key reasons.
corrected_semantics.verify_inputs_manifest(require_no_pendin: Any pending entry blocks verification (canonical generation may not proceed without a digest pin).
corrected_semantics.check_proj_environment(reject_foreign_pr: A PROJ_LIB/PROJ_DATA env var that does not match pyproj's resolved data dir flips ok=False (reported in new foreign_proj_vars field) instead of being a warning-only risk.
corrected_semantics.check_proj_environment(require_layout_kn: An undeterminable proj.db DATABASE.LAYOUT.VERSION.MINOR flips ok=False instead of 'unknown but fine'.
corrected_semantics.backwards_compat: Both new guard flags default to False, preserving historic loud-warn behavior for the startup path in main_pipeline; only canonical generation opts into fail-closed.
corrected_semantics.canonical_regen: _check_proj_env now calls check_proj_environment(min_layout_minor=6, fail_closed=True, reject_foreign_proj=True, require_layout_known=True). _verify_manifest(profile) enforces REQUIRED_INPUT_KEYS_BY_PROFILE: PERCEPTION_RELEASE -> [roads_osm, buildings, dem] (DEM required because the enriched map uses DEM vertical authority); other profiles -> [roads_osm]. Provenance now records manifest_sha256, schema version, profile, required/checked/pending/unused keys and require_no_pending in regen_provenance.json and manifest_verification.json.

coverage.A: strict require_pinned_keys passes when all required keys verified
coverage.B: required key that is pending blocks with 'not digest verified' reasons
coverage.C: required key missing from manifest blocks
coverage.D: require_no_pending blocks any pending entry; lenient default still reports pending
coverage.E: regen._verify_manifest('PERCEPTION_RELEASE') enforces the three required keys and records sha/unused
coverage.E2: regen._verify_manifest blocks when buildings is still pending
coverage.G: regen._check_proj_env calls the probe with fail_closed/reject_foreign_proj/require_layout_known=True and propagates ProjEnvironmentError
coverage.H: reject_foreign_proj flips ok=False; default keeps foreign env var as warning-only
coverage.I: require_layout_known flips ok=False on unknown layout; default remains tolerant
coverage.K: _emit_candidate records the strict manifest_verification block in provenance
coverage.L: real committed campaign manifest satisfies the strict PERCEPTION_RELEASE requirements on disk

regression_results.focused: 15 passed (plus existing manifest/proj guard suites green)

residual_risks: REQUIRED_INPUT_KEYS_BY_PROFILE covers the five regen CLI release profiles; a future profile that introduces a new enrichment authority must extend the map explicitly or it inherits the roads_osm-only floor.

The DEM requirement is hard-wired into PERCEPTION_RELEASE. If the final vertical authority later becomes PLANAR (no DEM), the profile logic must be updated to legitimately drop dem from the required set rather than keeping it pinned.

tools/validate_thesis_claim_provenance.py and main_pipeline._verify_pinned_inputs still run lenient verification (no required-key sets); they were not changed in OC-37 (separate tapes) and remain lenient by design for their historical-peer roles.
